integrity: The result is derived from an explicit overlap maximization, exact pure-state relative-entropy and max-relative-entropy reductions, a matching hypothesis-test effect, and a matching trace-preserving smoothing construction. The motivating source supplies only coarser bounds for this example.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the commuting specialization \([\rho,\omega]=0\) of the correlated family in Example 24; no formula is claimed for the noncommuting family or arbitrary correlated composite hypotheses. Finite computations are corroborative, not proofs.
title: Exact finite-block formulas in a commuting correlated zero-Stein-rate family
